description: Source code for the rpmsg_service module in Zephyr OS, implementing inter-processor communication via rpmsg with initialization, endpoint registration, and message sending functionalities.

methods.name: rpmsg_service_unbind
methods.description: Unbinds an rpmsg endpoint by destroying it.

methods.name: ns_bind_cb
methods.description: Callback for namespace binding, creates endpoints based on name matching.

methods.name: rpmsg_service_init
methods.description: Initializes the rpmsg service, sets up virtio device, shared memory, and endpoints.

methods.name: rpmsg_service_register_endpoint
methods.description: Registers a new endpoint with a name and callback, returns endpoint ID or error.

methods.name: rpmsg_service_endpoint_is_bound
methods.description: Checks if a given endpoint is bound.

methods.name: rpmsg_service_send
methods.description: Sends data over a specified endpoint.
